words.enDefinition: Continuous passage through which food and its remnants move through the body

examples.en: The diagram traces the digestive tract from the mouth to its final opening.
examples.zh: 示意图描出了「消化道」从口腔到其末端开口的全程。

examples.en: We colored the digestive tract separately from the organs that send secretions into it.
examples.zh: 我们给「消化道」和向其中输送分泌物的器官分别用了不同的颜色。

words.enDefinition: Structure that assists digestion without belonging to the main passage for food

examples.en: The liver is labeled as an accessory digestive organ beside the digestive tract model.
examples.zh: 消化道模型旁的肝脏被标为「消化附属器官」。

examples.en: The worksheet traces a duct from an accessory digestive organ to the small intestine.
examples.zh: 习题描出了从「消化附属器官」通往小肠的一条导管。

collocations: function of an accessory digestive organ

words.enDefinition: Space inside the mouth containing the tongue and enclosed by surrounding tissues

examples.en: The side view shows the oral cavity beneath the roof of the mouth.
examples.zh: 侧视图显示「口腔」位于上腭下方。

examples.en: We identified the tongue as a structure within the oral cavity on our model.
examples.zh: 我们在模型上辨认出舌是「口腔」内的一个结构。

words.enDefinition: Gland that produces saliva and releases it into the oral cavity

examples.en: The chart marks a salivary gland with a duct leading into the mouth.
examples.zh: 图表标出一处「唾液腺」，它的导管通入口腔。

examples.en: We followed the illustrated duct from the salivary gland to its opening.
examples.zh: 我们沿图示导管，从「唾液腺」一直看到它的开口。

words.enDefinition: Enzyme in saliva that begins breaking starch into smaller carbohydrates

examples.en: The lecture places salivary amylase at the beginning of starch digestion in humans.
examples.zh: 课堂将「唾液淀粉酶」的作用放在人体淀粉消化的起始阶段。

examples.en: Our flowchart shows that salivary amylase starts breaking down starch in the mouth.
examples.zh: 流程图显示，「唾液淀粉酶」在口腔内开始分解淀粉。

words.enDefinition: Soft mass of chewed material prepared for swallowing in the mouth

examples.en: The diagram shows a food bolus forming from chewed material mixed with saliva.
examples.zh: 图中显示咀嚼后的食物和唾液混合在一起，形成「食团」。

examples.en: We traced the food bolus from the mouth toward the illustrated esophagus.
examples.zh: 我们在图中追踪「食团」从口腔向食管移动的过程。

words.enDefinition: Automatic sequence that moves swallowed material through the pharynx toward the esophagus

examples.en: The swallowing reflex diagram shows the passage of a food bolus through the pharynx.
examples.zh: 「吞咽反射」示意图显示食团经过咽部的过程。

examples.en: The animation shows the swallowing reflex taking over as the bolus enters the pharynx.
examples.zh: 动画显示，食团进入咽部时，「吞咽反射」开始主导接下来的运动。

words.enDefinition: Muscular tube carrying swallowed material from the pharynx to the stomach

examples.en: The esophagus runs behind the airway in the model's side view.
examples.zh: 在模型侧视图中，「食管」沿气道后方延伸。

examples.en: We traced the esophagus down to the top of the stomach.
examples.zh: 我们沿着「食管」往下看到它连接胃的上端。

words.enDefinition: High-pressure muscular region at the stomach entrance that limits backward flow

examples.en: The lower esophageal sphincter lies where the esophagus meets the stomach in our model.
examples.zh: 在我们的模型中，「下食管括约肌」位于食管和胃交界处。

examples.en: The animation shows the lower esophageal sphincter relaxing briefly as the bolus passes into the stomach.
examples.zh: 动画展示了食团进入胃内时，「下食管括约肌」短暂松弛。

collocations: location of the lower esophageal sphincter
pressure at the lower esophageal sphincter
diagram of the lower esophageal sphincter

words.enDefinition: Coordinated traveling waves of muscular contraction moving material along a tubular organ

examples.en: The animation illustrates peristalsis by moving a contraction wave along the esophagus.
examples.zh: 动画通过食管中向前传播的收缩波来说明「蠕动」。

examples.en: We used arrows to show the direction of peristalsis in the tube model.
examples.zh: 我们用箭头标出管道模型中「蠕动」波前进的方向。

words.enDefinition: Innermost digestive wall layer containing surface epithelium and underlying tissue

examples.en: The gastrointestinal mucosa faces the interior space of the illustrated digestive tube.
examples.zh: 「胃肠道黏膜」朝向图示消化管的内部空间。

examples.en: We colored the gastrointestinal mucosa before marking the deeper layers of the wall.
examples.zh: 我们先给「胃肠道黏膜」上色，再标出管壁较深的各层。

words.enDefinition: Supporting connective tissue layer beneath the mucosa in many tubular organs

examples.en: The submucosa is shown directly beneath the inner lining of the intestinal wall.
examples.zh: 示意图显示，「黏膜下层」就在肠壁内衬的下方。

examples.en: We identified small vessels within the submucosa in the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂示意图中辨认了「黏膜下层」内的小血管。

words.enDefinition: Digestive wall layer whose organized muscle layers move and mix contents

examples.en: The model shows two major muscle orientations in the muscularis externa of the intestine.
examples.zh: 模型展示了肠道「外肌层」中肌纤维的两种主要排列方向。

examples.en: We shaded the muscularis externa outside the submucosa in the intestinal wall drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在肠壁图中给黏膜下层外侧的「外肌层」涂上阴影。

collocations: circular muscle in the muscularis externa

words.enDefinition: Interior space of the stomach where food mixes with gastric secretions

examples.en: The gastric lumen is the open region inside the stomach's outline on the diagram.
examples.zh: 「胃腔」是示意图中胃壁轮廓内的空间。

examples.en: We drew arrows into the gastric lumen to represent the stomach's secretions.
examples.zh: 我们画出指向「胃腔」内的箭头，表示胃的分泌物进入其中。

words.enDefinition: Rounded upper part of the stomach lying above the esophageal entry

examples.en: The gastric fundus forms a dome above the esophageal opening in our model.
examples.zh: 模型中的「胃底」呈穹隆状，位于食管开口上方。

examples.en: We marked the gastric fundus near the spleen in the upper abdominal model.
examples.zh: 我们在上腹部模型中靠近脾脏的位置标出了「胃底」。

collocations: upper curve of the gastric fundus

words.enDefinition: Large central region of the stomach between the fundus and lower portion

examples.en: The gastric body occupies most of the central area in this simplified stomach diagram.
examples.zh: 在这张简化胃示意图中，「胃体」占据中央区域的大部分。

examples.en: We distinguished the gastric body from the rounded upper portion on the model.
examples.zh: 我们在模型上区分了「胃体」和上方的圆隆部分。

words.enDefinition: Lower stomach region that leads toward the pyloric canal and outlet

examples.en: The outline narrows beyond the gastric antrum as it approaches the stomach outlet.
examples.zh: 胃的轮廓越过「胃窦」后，接近胃出口处逐渐变窄。

examples.en: We marked the gastric antrum below the large central portion of our model.
examples.zh: 我们在模型的中央大部下方标出了「胃窦」。

words.enDefinition: Muscular ring controlling passage from the stomach into the duodenum

examples.en: The model places the pyloric sphincter at the outlet of the stomach.
examples.zh: 模型将「幽门括约肌」画在胃的出口处。

examples.en: The diagram shows chyme moving past the pyloric sphincter into the duodenum.
examples.zh: 示意图显示食糜经过「幽门括约肌」进入十二指肠。

words.enDefinition: Folds of the stomach lining that flatten as the organ expands

examples.en: The empty stomach diagram shows gastric rugae as prominent folds along its inner surface.
examples.zh: 空胃示意图将「胃皱襞」画成内表面上一道道明显的褶皱。

examples.en: We compared the gastric rugae in two drawings showing different degrees of stomach expansion.
examples.zh: 我们比较了两幅胃扩张程度不同的图中的「胃皱襞」。

words.enDefinition: Small surface depression in the stomach lining into which gastric glands open

examples.en: The atlas shows a gastric pit dipping down from the stomach's inner surface.
examples.zh: 图谱显示一个「胃小凹」从胃内表面向下凹入。

examples.en: We labeled the gastric pit above the deeper gland in the enlarged drawing.
examples.zh: 我们在放大图中给深层腺体上方的「胃小凹」加了标注。

words.enDefinition: Secretory structure in the stomach lining that opens into a gastric pit

examples.en: The gastric gland is drawn beneath the opening in the stomach lining.
examples.zh: 「胃腺」被画在胃内衬开口的下方。

examples.en: We drew an arrow from the gastric gland toward the interior of the stomach.
examples.zh: 我们画出从「胃腺」指向胃腔的箭头。

words.enDefinition: Stomach secretion containing acid and substances that participate in digestion

examples.en: The classroom diagram shows gastric juice mixing with swallowed material inside the stomach.
examples.zh: 课堂图显示「胃液」在胃内与吞下的物质混合。

examples.en: Our lesson separates gastric juice from the material later added by the pancreas.
examples.zh: 课堂把「胃液」与之后由胰腺加入消化道的物质分开介绍。

words.enDefinition: Movement of stomach contents into the first part of the small intestine

examples.en: The animation uses arrows to represent gastric emptying through the stomach outlet.
examples.zh: 动画用箭头表示胃内容物经过出口的「胃排空」过程。

examples.en: We compared gastric emptying with mixing inside the stomach on our flowchart.
examples.zh: 我们在流程图中比较了「胃排空」与胃内混合过程。

words.enDefinition: Semifluid mixture formed when stomach secretions mix with partially digested food

examples.en: The diagram depicts chyme after the stomach mixes its contents thoroughly.
examples.zh: 示意图展示了胃充分混合内容物后形成的「食糜」。

examples.en: Our model shows chyme passing into the first part of the small intestine.
examples.zh: 我们的模型显示「食糜」进入小肠的第一段。

collocations: passage of chyme into the duodenum

words.enDefinition: Digestive tube between stomach and large intestine where most nutrient absorption occurs

examples.en: The small intestine is drawn in loops between the stomach and large intestine.
examples.zh: 「小肠」在胃与大肠之间画成多段盘曲的肠襻。

examples.en: We labeled three successive regions of the small intestine on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在习题图上标出了「小肠」依次相连的三个肠段。

collocations: nutrient absorption in the small intestine

words.enDefinition: First part of the small intestine, receiving stomach contents and accessory secretions

examples.en: The duodenum begins just beyond the outlet of the illustrated stomach.
examples.zh: 「十二指肠」起于图示胃出口的远端。

examples.en: The tutor traced the ducts entering the duodenum in the enlarged digestive diagram.
examples.zh: 老师在放大的消化系统示意图上描出了通入「十二指肠」的导管。

words.enDefinition: Middle portion of the small intestine between the duodenum and ileum

examples.en: The model colors the jejunum differently from the two adjacent intestinal regions.
examples.zh: 模型用不同颜色区分「空肠」和相邻的两个肠段。

examples.en: We placed the label for the jejunum in the middle portion of the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们把「空肠」的标签放在示意图中的小肠中段。

words.enDefinition: Final portion of the small intestine leading to the large intestine

examples.en: The ileum leads into the first part of the large intestine in the model.
examples.zh: 在模型中，「回肠」通入大肠的第一段。

examples.en: We marked the ileum at the far end of the small intestine.
examples.zh: 我们在小肠的末端标出了「回肠」。

collocations: junction of the ileum and cecum

words.enDefinition: Junctional valve regulating passage from the ileum into the cecum

examples.en: The ileocecal valve is drawn where the small intestine joins the large intestine.
examples.zh: 「回盲瓣」被画在小肠与大肠相接的位置。

examples.en: We followed the illustrated contents past the ileocecal valve into the cecum.
examples.zh: 我们在图中追踪肠内容物经过「回盲瓣」进入盲肠的路径。

words.enDefinition: Small fingerlike projection enlarging the absorptive surface of the small intestine

examples.en: The tutor enlarged one intestinal villus to show the structures inside it.
examples.zh: 老师放大了一根「肠绒毛」，展示其内部结构。

examples.en: We marked an intestinal villus projecting into the open space of the intestine.
examples.zh: 我们标出一根向肠腔内突出的「肠绒毛」。

words.enDefinition: Tiny projections on individual intestinal epithelial cells that enlarge their surface

examples.en: The intestinal microvilli appear along the exposed side of one enlarged epithelial cell.
examples.zh: 在一个放大的上皮细胞朝向肠腔的一侧可以看见「肠上皮微绒毛」。

examples.en: The atlas zooms in beyond the villus to show intestinal microvilli on individual cells.
examples.zh: 图谱从绒毛进一步放大，展示单个细胞上的「肠上皮微绒毛」。

words.enDefinition: Small lymphatic vessel inside a villus receiving products of fat absorption

examples.en: The drawing places a lacteal near the center of the intestinal villus.
examples.zh: 图中「乳糜管」位于肠绒毛中央附近。

examples.en: We colored the lacteal separately from the small blood vessels beside it.
examples.zh: 我们给「乳糜管」及其旁边的小血管分别涂上不同颜色。

words.enDefinition: The fringe formed by densely packed microvilli on the exposed surface of absorptive intestinal cells.

examples.en: The intestinal brush border appears as a narrow fringe along the row of absorptive cells.
examples.zh: 「肠刷状缘」在一排吸收细胞沿肠腔的一侧呈现为一道窄边。

examples.en: Our enlarged diagram shows the intestinal brush border formed by many packed microvilli.
examples.zh: 放大图显示「肠刷状缘」由许多密集的微绒毛组成。

collocations: surface of the intestinal brush border
diagram of the intestinal brush border

words.enDefinition: Movement of digested substances and other materials across the intestinal lining

examples.en: The diagram represents intestinal absorption with arrows moving from the lumen into the tissue.
examples.zh: 示意图用从肠腔指向组织内的箭头表示「肠道吸收」。

examples.en: We compared regions of intestinal absorption on the same simplified digestive map.
examples.zh: 我们在同一张简化消化系统图中比较了「肠道吸收」发生的不同区域。

words.enDefinition: Final major region of the digestive tract, recovering water and forming feces

examples.en: The large intestine frames the loops of the smaller intestine in our model.
examples.zh: 模型中，「大肠」围绕在盘曲的小肠外侧。

examples.en: We marked the starting point of the large intestine where the ileum connects.
examples.zh: 我们在回肠相接的位置标出了「大肠」的起点。

words.enDefinition: Pouch at the beginning of the large intestine that receives ileal contents

examples.en: The cecum appears as a pouch below the ileal opening in the diagram.
examples.zh: 示意图中，「盲肠」呈囊状，位于回肠开口的下方。

examples.en: We labeled the cecum before tracing the colon upward on the model.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「盲肠」，再在模型上沿结肠向上描画。

words.enDefinition: Major section of the large intestine extending from cecum toward rectum

examples.en: The colon is shown in four labeled sections on our chart.
examples.zh: 我们的图表把「结肠」画成四个标有名称的肠段。

examples.en: We followed the colon around the loops of small intestine in the model.
examples.zh: 我们在模型上沿「结肠」观察它如何围绕小肠的各段肠襻。

words.enDefinition: Part of the colon running upward along the body's right side

examples.en: The ascending colon runs upward on the right side of the model's body.
examples.zh: 模型中，「升结肠」沿人体右侧向上延伸。

examples.en: We traced the ascending colon from the pouch toward the upper bend.
examples.zh: 我们沿「升结肠」从盲肠囊状处向上描到弯曲处。

collocations: upper end of the ascending colon

words.enDefinition: Portion of the colon crossing the abdomen between ascending and descending parts

examples.en: The transverse colon runs across the upper part of the classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 在课堂示意图上，「横结肠」横过上部。

examples.en: We labeled the transverse colon between the two bends shown in the model.
examples.zh: 我们在模型所示的两个弯曲处之间标出了「横结肠」。

words.enDefinition: Part of the colon running downward along the body's left side

examples.en: The descending colon runs downward on the anatomical left in our diagram.
examples.zh: 示意图中，「降结肠」沿人体的左侧向下延伸。

examples.en: We traced the descending colon from the upper bend to the curved lower section.
examples.zh: 我们从上方转折处沿「降结肠」看到下方弯曲的结肠段。

collocations: lower end of the descending colon

words.enDefinition: Curved final section of the colon leading into the rectum

examples.en: The sigmoid colon forms a curve before joining the rectum in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中的「乙状结肠」在与直肠相接之前形成一处弯曲。

examples.en: Our tutor marked the sigmoid colon after labeling the straight descending portion above it.
examples.zh: 老师先标出其上方较直的降结肠段，再标出「乙状结肠」。

collocations: junction of the sigmoid colon and rectum

words.enDefinition: Final major section of the large intestine between sigmoid colon and anal canal

examples.en: The rectum lies below the curved end of the colon in our diagram.
examples.zh: 示意图中，「直肠」位于结肠弯曲末段的下方。

examples.en: We drew the rectum as the segment above the anal canal.
examples.zh: 我们把肛管上方的一段画成「直肠」。

words.enDefinition: Large abdominal organ that processes absorbed substances and produces bile

examples.en: Our model shows the liver above much of the digestive tract.
examples.zh: 模型中，「肝脏」位于大部分消化道的上方。

examples.en: The diagram traces the route of bile leaving the liver through ducts.
examples.zh: 示意图描出了胆汁沿导管离开「肝脏」的路径。

words.enDefinition: Classical structural unit of the liver organized around a central vein

examples.en: The hepatic lobule is drawn around a central vein in the textbook figure.
examples.zh: 教材图中，「肝小叶」以中央静脉为中心绘出。

examples.en: We marked the center and outer edges of one hepatic lobule on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在习题图上标出了一个「肝小叶」的中央和外缘。

collocations: central vein of a hepatic lobule

words.enDefinition: Group of small portal vein, hepatic artery, and bile duct branches

examples.en: The diagram places a portal triad at one corner of the classical lobule.
examples.zh: 示意图将一个「门管三联体」画在经典肝小叶的一个角上。

examples.en: We identified the duct and both vessel branches within the portal triad.
examples.zh: 我们在「门管三联体」中辨认出胆管和两条血管分支。

words.enDefinition: Small organ beneath the liver that stores and concentrates bile

examples.en: The gallbladder appears below the liver in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 在课堂模型中，「胆囊」位于肝脏下方。

examples.en: We traced the duct connecting the gallbladder to the wider biliary system.
examples.zh: 我们描出了连接「胆囊」与其他胆道结构的导管。

words.enDefinition: Liquid made by the liver that assists fat digestion in the intestine

examples.en: The lecture shows bile entering the first part of the small intestine.
examples.zh: 课堂图示中，「胆汁」流入小肠的第一段。

examples.en: We used different arrows for bile and other digestive secretions in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在示意图中用不同的箭头区分「胆汁」和其他消化分泌物。

words.enDefinition: Duct formed by the main right and left ducts draining the liver

examples.en: The common hepatic duct begins where the right and left hepatic ducts join.
examples.zh: 「肝总管」起自左、右肝管汇合处。

examples.en: We labeled the common hepatic duct above its junction with the cystic duct.
examples.zh: 我们在与胆囊管汇合位置的上方标出了「肝总管」。

collocations: formation of the common hepatic duct
common hepatic duct in a biliary diagram

words.enDefinition: Passage connecting the gallbladder with the main ducts carrying bile

examples.en: The cystic duct connects the gallbladder to the other ducts in the model.
examples.zh: 在模型中，「胆囊管」把胆囊和其他胆管连接起来。

examples.en: Our tutor marked the cystic duct while tracing the route between liver and gallbladder.
examples.zh: 老师在沿肝脏到胆囊的路径讲解时标出了「胆囊管」。

words.enDefinition: Passage formed by the union of the common hepatic and cystic ducts

examples.en: The common bile duct continues downward toward the duodenum in our simplified model.
examples.zh: 在简化模型中，「胆总管」继续向下通往十二指肠。

examples.en: We traced the common bile duct below the point where its two branches join.
examples.zh: 我们沿着两条胆管汇合处下方描出了「胆总管」。

collocations: course of the common bile duct
flow through the common bile duct

words.enDefinition: Passage carrying digestive secretions from the pancreas toward the duodenum

examples.en: The pancreatic duct runs through the elongated gland in the classroom drawing.
examples.zh: 课堂示意图中，「胰管」贯穿这个细长的腺体。

examples.en: We traced the pancreatic duct to the intestinal wall on the model.
examples.zh: 我们在模型上沿着「胰管」追踪到肠壁。

words.enDefinition: Pancreatic tissue producing digestive secretions that leave the gland through ducts

examples.en: The exocrine pancreas connects to the ducts shown in our simplified gland drawing.
examples.zh: 我们的简化腺体图显示，「胰腺外分泌部」与导管相连。

examples.en: We identified the exocrine pancreas as the portion that sends secretions toward the intestine.
examples.zh: 我们把向肠道输送分泌物的部分辨认为「胰腺外分泌部」。

words.enDefinition: Digestive secretion containing enzymes and bicarbonate, released by the exocrine pancreas

examples.en: The flowchart shows pancreatic juice entering the duodenum after leaving the gland.
examples.zh: 流程图显示「胰液」离开胰腺后进入十二指肠。

examples.en: We labeled pancreatic juice as one of the secretions that arrive from outside the intestine.
examples.zh: 我们把「胰液」标为从肠道外进入肠腔的分泌物之一。

words.enDefinition: Dispersion of larger fat droplets into smaller droplets during intestinal digestion

examples.en: The emulsification of fats drawing replaces one large droplet with many smaller droplets.
examples.zh: 「脂肪乳化」示意图把一个大的脂滴画成许多小脂滴。

examples.en: The lecture links the emulsification of fats to the action of bile salts in the intestine.
examples.zh: 课堂将「脂肪乳化」与胆盐在肠道中的作用联系起来。

words.enDefinition: Organs forming, transporting, storing, and eliminating urine

examples.en: The urinary system model connects both kidneys to the bladder through two tubes.
examples.zh: 「泌尿系统」模型用两根管道将两侧肾脏与膀胱相连。

examples.en: We traced the urinary system downward from the kidneys in the classroom figure.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图上从肾脏向下描画「泌尿系统」。

words.enDefinition: Organ that filters blood and regulates body fluids while forming urine

examples.en: The kidney model shows an outer region surrounding a darker inner region.
examples.zh: 「肾脏」模型显示外部区域围绕颜色较深的内部区域。

examples.en: We labeled the kidney beside its connection to the urinary tract.
examples.zh: 我们在通往尿路的连接处旁标出了「肾脏」。

words.enDefinition: Fibrous covering directly surrounding the outer surface of the kidney

examples.en: The renal capsule appears as a thin line around the model kidney.
examples.zh: 「肾被膜」在肾脏模型外周呈现为一条细线。

examples.en: We outlined the renal capsule separately from the broader layer of surrounding fat.
examples.zh: 我们分别勾画出「肾被膜」和周围较厚的脂肪层。

collocations: outer surface of the renal capsule

words.enDefinition: Indented area where the kidney's vessels, nerves, and urinary passage connect

examples.en: The renal hilum is marked along the curved inward border of the kidney.
examples.zh: 「肾门」标在肾脏向内凹陷的边缘。

examples.en: Our diagram groups several structures at the renal hilum using different colored lines.
examples.zh: 示意图用不同颜色的线条标出汇集在「肾门」的几种结构。

words.enDefinition: Outer region of the kidney containing the renal corpuscles and convoluted tubules

examples.en: The renal cortex forms an outer band around the darker region in our drawing.
examples.zh: 在图中，「肾皮质」形成环绕较深色区域的一圈外带。

examples.en: We placed the tiny filtration units within the renal cortex on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在图中把微小的滤过单位画在「肾皮质」内。

words.enDefinition: Inner region of the kidney containing the pyramids and parts of tubules

examples.en: We shaded the renal medulla deeper inside the kidney model than the cortex.
examples.zh: 我们在肾脏模型比皮质更深的位置以阴影表示「肾髓质」。

examples.en: The diagram groups the triangular structures within the renal medulla of the section.
examples.zh: 剖面图将三角形结构标在「肾髓质」内。

words.enDefinition: Cone-shaped region of kidney medulla ending at a papilla

examples.en: The illustration shows a renal pyramid with its narrow tip pointing inward.
examples.zh: 插图显示一个尖端朝内的「肾锥体」。

examples.en: We colored one renal pyramid to distinguish it from the surrounding tissue.
examples.zh: 我们为一个「肾锥体」上色，将其与周围组织区分开来。

words.enDefinition: Extension of cortical tissue between adjacent renal pyramids in the kidney

examples.en: The renal column separates two triangular regions in our cutaway kidney model.
examples.zh: 在肾脏剖视模型中，「肾柱」隔开两个三角形区域。

examples.en: We followed the renal column outward to the band of cortical tissue.
examples.zh: 我们沿着「肾柱」向外描画，直到带状皮质组织。

words.enDefinition: Tip of a kidney pyramid from which collecting ducts release urine

examples.en: The renal papilla points into the small cup drawn on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 习题图中，「肾乳头」伸向一个小杯状结构内部。

examples.en: We marked the renal papilla at the narrow end of the pyramid.
examples.zh: 我们在锥体的窄端标出了「肾乳头」。

words.enDefinition: Small cup-shaped space collecting urine discharged from a renal papilla

examples.en: One minor calyx surrounds the tip of a pyramid in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中，一个「肾小盏」围住一个肾锥体的尖端。

examples.en: We drew an arrow from the minor calyx into a larger collecting space.
examples.zh: 我们从「肾小盏」画了一个指向较大集合腔的箭头。

words.enDefinition: Larger collecting space formed where several minor calyces join within the kidney

examples.en: Several smaller cups join to form the major calyx in the drawing.
examples.zh: 在图中，几个较小的杯状结构相汇形成「肾大盏」。

examples.en: We labeled the major calyx before the pathway opens into the renal pelvis.
examples.zh: 我们在尿路通入肾盂之前的位置标出了「肾大盏」。

words.enDefinition: Funnel-shaped collecting area of the kidney that continues into the ureter

examples.en: The renal pelvis narrows into a tube leaving the kidney in the diagram.
examples.zh: 图中，「肾盂」变窄成为离开肾脏的管道。

examples.en: We traced the renal pelvis back toward the larger cups of the kidney.
examples.zh: 我们从「肾盂」向上追踪到肾内较大的肾盏。

words.enDefinition: Muscular tube that carries urine from one kidney to the bladder

examples.en: We followed the ureter from the kidney down to the bladder.
examples.zh: 我们沿「输尿管」从肾脏向下追踪到膀胱。

examples.en: The diagram shows a separate ureter leaving each side of the model.
examples.zh: 图中，模型两侧各有一根「输尿管」从肾脏引出。

words.enDefinition: Hollow muscular organ storing urine before it leaves through the urethra

examples.en: The urinary bladder is drawn below both kidneys in the model's front view.
examples.zh: 在模型正视图中，「膀胱」画在两侧肾脏的下方。

examples.en: We labeled the incoming tubes at the base of the urinary bladder.
examples.zh: 我们在「膀胱」底部标出了通入其中的管道。

words.enDefinition: Triangular internal region between the two ureter openings and the urethral opening

examples.en: Three marked openings outline the bladder trigone in our classroom diagram.
examples.zh: 课堂图上三个标出的开口勾勒出「膀胱三角」。

examples.en: The guide shades the bladder trigone at the bottom of the bladder model.
examples.zh: 导图在膀胱模型底部用阴影表示「膀胱三角」。

words.enDefinition: Smooth muscle forming the bladder wall and contracting during emptying

examples.en: The detrusor muscle forms the thick wall shown on the bladder diagram.
examples.zh: 「逼尿肌」构成膀胱示意图中较厚的肌壁。

examples.en: Our animation shows the detrusor muscle shortening as the modeled bladder empties.
examples.zh: 我们的动画显示模型膀胱排空时，「逼尿肌」收缩变短。

words.enDefinition: Tube carrying urine from the bladder to the outside of the body

examples.en: The figure shows the urethra leaving the bladder through its lower opening.
examples.zh: 图示显示「尿道」从膀胱下方开口引出。

examples.en: We labeled the urethra after tracing the final part of the urinary pathway.
examples.zh: 我们沿尿路末段看到其出口后，标出了「尿道」。

words.enDefinition: Physiological process in which urine leaves the bladder through the urethra

examples.en: The lecture diagram represents micturition with an arrow leading out of the bladder.
examples.zh: 课堂图用一个从膀胱引出的箭头表示「排尿」。

examples.en: We compared the diagrams for bladder filling and micturition on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们比较了习题中膀胱充盈与「排尿」的两幅示意图。

words.enDefinition: Functional unit of the kidney containing a filtration structure and a tubule

examples.en: We drew a nephron with a round structure attached to several tubular segments.
examples.zh: 我们画了一个「肾单位」，其中一处圆形结构连着多段小管。

examples.en: The atlas uses different colors for successive parts of one nephron.
examples.zh: 图谱用不同颜色表示同一个「肾单位」中依次相连的各部分。

words.enDefinition: Nephron component composed of the glomerulus and its surrounding capsule

examples.en: The renal corpuscle includes the capillary tuft and its outer cup in our model.
examples.zh: 在模型中，「肾小体」包括毛细血管团和包围它的杯状结构。

examples.en: We marked the renal corpuscle at the beginning of the nephron diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在肾单位示意图的起始处标出了「肾小体」。

words.enDefinition: Tuft of capillaries within the renal corpuscle where blood filtration begins

examples.en: The glomerulus appears as a cluster of loops within the larger cup.
examples.zh: 「肾小球」在较大的杯状结构内部呈现为一团环状血管。

examples.en: We highlighted the glomerulus before tracing the surrounding space in our diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先高亮标出「肾小球」，再描出它周围的空隙。

words.enDefinition: Cup-shaped portion of the renal corpuscle surrounding the filtering capillaries

examples.en: The glomerular capsule wraps around the capillary tuft in the simplified illustration.
examples.zh: 在简化图中，「肾小囊」包围毛细血管团。

examples.en: We drew the glomerular capsule opening into the first tubular segment on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在习题图中把「肾小囊」画成通向第一段肾小管的结构。

words.enDefinition: Layered interface controlling movement from glomerular blood into the capsule space

examples.en: The atlas shows the glomerular filtration barrier between blood and the capsule space.
examples.zh: 图谱显示「肾小球滤过屏障」位于血液与肾小囊腔之间。

examples.en: We labeled several layers of the glomerular filtration barrier in the enlarged cross section.
examples.zh: 我们在放大的横截面图中标出了「肾小球滤过屏障」的多个层次。

collocations: layers of the glomerular filtration barrier
diagram of the glomerular filtration barrier
role of the glomerular filtration barrier

words.enDefinition: Specialized epithelial cell with processes covering glomerular capillaries as part of filtration

examples.en: The enlarged figure shows a podocyte wrapping its processes around a capillary.
examples.zh: 放大图显示一个「足细胞」的突起包绕毛细血管。

examples.en: We marked the extensions of one podocyte on the filtration diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在滤过示意图上标出了一个「足细胞」的突起。

words.enDefinition: Small artery bringing blood into the glomerular capillary tuft

examples.en: The arrow from the afferent arteriole points into the capillary tuft in our diagram.
examples.zh: 图中从「入球小动脉」出发的箭头指向毛细血管团。

examples.en: We labeled the afferent arteriole on the incoming side of the corpuscle.
examples.zh: 我们在肾小体的血流流入侧标出了「入球小动脉」。

words.enDefinition: Small artery carrying blood away from the glomerular capillary tuft

examples.en: The efferent arteriole leaves the capillary tuft in the simplified diagram of circulation.
examples.zh: 在简化循环图中，「出球小动脉」从毛细血管团引出。

examples.en: We marked the efferent arteriole with an arrow pointing away from the glomerulus.
examples.zh: 我们用指向远离肾小球方向的箭头标出了「出球小动脉」。

words.enDefinition: Small vessels surrounding kidney tubules and exchanging water and solutes with them

examples.en: The peritubular capillaries form a fine network around the coiled tubules in our diagram.
examples.zh: 图中的「管周毛细血管」围绕弯曲的小管形成细密的血管网。

examples.en: Our animation shows fluid entering the peritubular capillaries from the surrounding tissue.
examples.zh: 我们的动画显示液体从周围组织进入「管周毛细血管」。

words.enDefinition: Straight capillary loops accompanying long nephron loops in the renal medulla

examples.en: The vasa recta run beside the long nephron loop on the enlarged diagram.
examples.zh: 在放大图中，「直小血管」沿较长的肾单位袢旁边延伸。

examples.en: We used blue lines to separate the vasa recta from the tubular pathway.
examples.zh: 我们用蓝色线条将「直小血管」与小管通路区分开来。

collocations: blood flow through the vasa recta

words.enDefinition: Coiled first segment of the renal tubule that receives glomerular filtrate

examples.en: The proximal convoluted tubule begins next to the glomerular capsule in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中，「近曲小管」起自肾小囊旁边。

examples.en: We marked the proximal convoluted tubule before drawing the long loop beneath it.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「近曲小管」，再绘制它下方的长袢。

collocations: reabsorption in the proximal convoluted tubule
diagram of the proximal convoluted tubule

words.enDefinition: U-shaped tubule segment between the proximal and distal portions of the nephron

examples.en: The nephron loop dips into the darker region shown in our kidney model.
examples.zh: 在肾脏模型中，「肾单位袢」伸入颜色较深的区域。

examples.en: We traced the two limbs of the nephron loop down and back up.
examples.zh: 我们描绘了「肾单位袢」一支向下、另一支折返向上的路径。

words.expression: descending limb of the nephron loop
words.lemma: descending limb of the nephron loop
words.enDefinition: Part of the hairpin-shaped tubule carrying fluid deeper into the kidney
acceptedEnVariants: descending limb of the nephron loop
descending limb of the loop of Henle

examples.en: Our arrows follow the descending limb of the nephron loop toward the hairpin turn.
examples.zh: 我们的箭头沿着「肾单位袢降支」指向发夹形弯折处。

examples.en: We marked the descending limb of the nephron loop before tracing the returning segment.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「肾单位袢降支」，再沿线描画折返回去的一段。

collocations: identify the descending limb of the nephron loop
flow through the descending limb of the nephron loop
diagram of the descending limb of the nephron loop

words.expression: ascending limb of the nephron loop
words.lemma: ascending limb of the nephron loop
words.enDefinition: Part of the hairpin-shaped tubule carrying fluid back toward the kidney cortex
acceptedEnVariants: ascending limb of the nephron loop
ascending limb of the loop of Henle

examples.en: The ascending limb of the nephron loop returns toward the kidney's outer part in the diagram.
examples.zh: 在图中，「肾单位袢升支」折返并朝肾脏外部的皮质方向延伸。

examples.en: We colored the ascending limb of the nephron loop after labeling the downward segment.
examples.zh: 我们给向下的一段加注名称后，为「肾单位袢升支」上色。

collocations: identify the ascending limb of the nephron loop
flow through the ascending limb of the nephron loop
diagram of the ascending limb of the nephron loop

words.enDefinition: Coiled portion of a nephron connecting the loop to the collecting pathway

examples.en: The distal convoluted tubule is curled near the top of our kidney diagram.
examples.zh: 「远曲小管」在肾脏图顶部附近呈弯曲状。

examples.en: We labeled the distal convoluted tubule after following fluid back from the nephron loop.
examples.zh: 我们沿肾单位袢折返的液流方向找到并标出了「远曲小管」。

collocations: transport in the distal convoluted tubule
diagram of the distal convoluted tubule

words.enDefinition: Tubular passage receiving fluid from several nephrons and carrying it onward

examples.en: Several small pathways join one collecting duct in the simplified model.
examples.zh: 在简化模型中，几条小通路汇入同一根「集合管」。

examples.en: We traced the collecting duct toward the inner tip of the pyramid.
examples.zh: 我们沿「集合管」描画到肾锥体朝内的尖端。

words.enDefinition: Nephron with corpuscle in the outer cortex and a relatively short loop

examples.en: The cortical nephron shown on the left has the shorter loop.
examples.zh: 左侧图中的「皮质肾单位」具有较短的肾单位袢。

examples.en: We located the corpuscle of the cortical nephron near the kidney's outer edge.
examples.zh: 我们在靠近肾脏外缘的位置找到了这个「皮质肾单位」的肾小体。

words.enDefinition: Nephron with corpuscle near the medulla and a long descending loop

examples.en: The loop of the juxtamedullary nephron extends deep into the kidney model.
examples.zh: 「近髓肾单位」的袢伸入肾脏模型的深部。

examples.en: We marked the corpuscle of the juxtamedullary nephron close to the inner region.
examples.zh: 我们在靠近肾脏内部区域的位置标出「近髓肾单位」的肾小体。

words.enDefinition: Movement of water and small solutes from glomerular blood into the capsule

examples.en: Our diagram shows glomerular filtration with arrows crossing from a vessel into the capsule.
examples.zh: 示意图用从血管跨入肾小囊的箭头表示「肾小球滤过」。

examples.en: The tutor discussed glomerular filtration before moving on to the tubules in the model.
examples.zh: 老师先讲解「肾小球滤过」，再介绍模型中的肾小管。

words.enDefinition: Fluid formed by filtration into the space of the glomerular capsule

examples.en: The blue space surrounding the capillaries contains glomerular filtrate in the schematic.
examples.zh: 示意图中，毛细血管周围的蓝色区域含有「肾小球滤液」。

examples.en: We followed glomerular filtrate from the capsule into the first tubular segment.
examples.zh: 我们沿流动方向从肾小囊追踪「肾小球滤液」进入第一段肾小管。

words.enDefinition: The total volume of filtrate entering the glomerular capsules of the functioning kidneys per unit time.

examples.en: The synthetic graph plots glomerular filtration rate against time for two hypothetical conditions.
examples.zh: 合成图绘出了两种假想条件下「肾小球滤过率」随时间的变化。

examples.en: We labeled glomerular filtration rate as a volume per unit time on the graph.
examples.zh: 我们在图上标明，「肾小球滤过率」的单位是每单位时间的体积。

collocations: glomerular filtration rate in a model

words.enDefinition: Return of water or solutes from kidney tubular fluid toward the blood

examples.en: The diagram shows tubular reabsorption with arrows pointing out of the nephron tube.
examples.zh: 示意图用从肾单位小管向外指的箭头表示「肾小管重吸收」。

examples.en: We marked the direction of tubular reabsorption before comparing it with tubular secretion.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「肾小管重吸收」的方向，再与肾小管分泌作比较。

words.enDefinition: Movement of certain substances from blood or surrounding tissue into kidney tubular fluid

examples.en: The tubular secretion arrows point into the tubular space in our schematic.
examples.zh: 示意图中表示「肾小管分泌」的箭头指向小管内部。

examples.en: We used a different color for tubular secretion in the transport diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在转运图中用另一种颜色表示「肾小管分泌」。

words.enDefinition: The process in nephron loops that builds a medullary concentration gradient through opposing flows and different transport properties in the two limbs.

examples.en: The countercurrent multiplication diagram shows fluid traveling in opposite directions along neighboring limbs.
examples.zh: 「逆流倍增」示意图显示相邻袢支内的液体朝相反方向流动。

examples.en: We used colors to show the gradient created by countercurrent multiplication in the model.
examples.zh: 我们用颜色表示模型中由「逆流倍增」建立的梯度。

words.enDefinition: Increase in interstitial fluid osmolality toward the inner renal medulla

examples.en: The diagram uses progressively darker colors to show the medullary osmotic gradient inside the kidney.
examples.zh: 示意图用逐渐加深的颜色表示肾内的「肾髓质渗透梯度」。

examples.en: We traced the medullary osmotic gradient from the outer region toward the inner tip.
examples.zh: 我们沿「肾髓质渗透梯度」从外侧区域追踪到内侧尖端。

collocations: diagram of the medullary osmotic gradient
role of the medullary osmotic gradient

words.enDefinition: Collection of tissues that release chemical signals into the body's internal fluids

examples.en: The endocrine system diagram highlights glands in several regions of the body.
examples.zh: 「内分泌系统」示意图突出标出了多个体区的腺体。

examples.en: We traced signals between two organs in the classroom endocrine system model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂「内分泌系统」模型中追踪两个器官之间的信号。

words.enDefinition: Gland releasing hormones into surrounding fluid for transport in the circulation

examples.en: The model shows an endocrine gland next to a network of blood vessels.
examples.zh: 模型显示一个「内分泌腺」位于一片血管网旁边。

examples.en: We labeled the endocrine gland that releases its signal into the surrounding fluid.
examples.zh: 我们标出了将信号释放到周围液体中的「内分泌腺」。

words.enDefinition: Release of a hormonal signal into internal fluid for transport to targets

examples.en: The drawing represents endocrine secretion with arrows pointing from cells toward nearby vessels.
examples.zh: 示意图用从细胞指向附近血管的箭头表示「内分泌」。

examples.en: We grouped endocrine secretion separately from secretion through a duct in the chart.
examples.zh: 我们在图表中将「内分泌」与经导管排出的分泌方式分开归类。

words.enDefinition: Chemical messenger released by cells that influences activity in other cells

examples.en: The diagram follows one hormone from its source to a distant tissue.
examples.zh: 示意图追踪一种「激素」从其产生处到远处组织的路径。

examples.en: We marked the gland producing the hormone shown in the classroom chart.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂图表中标出了产生该「激素」的腺体。

words.enDefinition: Cell able to respond to an endocrine signal through compatible receptors

examples.en: The example marks one endocrine target cell with receptors matching the illustrated signal.
examples.zh: 示例标出了一个「内分泌靶细胞」，它带有与图示信号对应的受体。

examples.en: We colored the endocrine target cell separately from the cells releasing the hormone.
examples.zh: 我们分别给「内分泌靶细胞」和释放激素的细胞涂上不同颜色。

collocations: receptor on an endocrine target cell
response of an endocrine target cell

words.enDefinition: Protein that recognizes a specific hormone and allows a cellular response

examples.en: Our diagram shows one hormone receptor recognizing the matching signal next to it.
examples.zh: 示意图显示一个「激素受体」识别它旁边与之匹配的信号。

examples.en: We labeled the hormone receptor separately from the signal that binds to it.
examples.zh: 我们分别标出了「激素受体」和与该受体结合的信号。

words.enDefinition: Regulation where a hormonal response reduces the signaling that originally produced it

examples.en: The endocrine negative feedback diagram shows a signal limiting its upstream stimulus.
examples.zh: 「内分泌负反馈」示意图显示一个信号限制其上游刺激。

examples.en: We used a backward arrow to mark endocrine negative feedback on the classroom flowchart.
examples.zh: 我们用一个反向箭头在课堂流程图上标出了「内分泌负反馈」。

words.enDefinition: Linked series of endocrine tissues coordinating a sequence of hormonal signals

examples.en: The worksheet shows an endocrine axis linking three levels of hormonal regulation.
examples.zh: 习题显示一条将三个激素调节层级连接起来的「内分泌轴」。

examples.en: We followed the endocrine axis from the brain region to the peripheral gland.
examples.zh: 我们沿「内分泌轴」从脑区追踪到外周腺体。

words.enDefinition: Signal produced by the hypothalamus that stimulates anterior pituitary hormone release

examples.en: The flowchart shows a hypothalamic releasing hormone reaching the anterior lobe through portal vessels.
examples.zh: 流程图显示一种「下丘脑释放激素」经门脉血管到达垂体前叶。

examples.en: We labeled the hypothalamic releasing hormone before tracing its downstream signal on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「下丘脑释放激素」，再沿图追踪其下游信号。

collocations: target of a hypothalamic releasing hormone
action of a hypothalamic releasing hormone

words.enDefinition: Small endocrine organ at the base of the brain with distinct lobes

examples.en: The pituitary gland is shown beneath the brain in the sagittal diagram.
examples.zh: 矢状面图把「垂体」画在脑的下方。

examples.en: We identified the pituitary gland before labeling its two major subdivisions.
examples.zh: 我们先辨认了「垂体」，再标出它的两个主要部分。

words.enDefinition: Front portion of the pituitary that produces and secretes several hormones

examples.en: The anterior pituitary is the larger front region in our simplified gland model.
examples.zh: 在简化腺体模型中，「垂体前叶」是前面较大的一部分。

examples.en: We labeled several signals originating in the anterior pituitary on our endocrine chart.
examples.zh: 我们在内分泌图表中标出了几个由「垂体前叶」产生的信号。

words.enDefinition: Back portion of the pituitary releasing hormones produced by the hypothalamus

examples.en: The posterior pituitary is shaded behind the glandular front lobe in the model.
examples.zh: 模型用阴影表示位于腺性前叶后方的「垂体后叶」。

examples.en: Our chart shows signals released from the posterior pituitary into nearby blood vessels.
examples.zh: 图表显示，信号由「垂体后叶」释放到附近血管中。

collocations: hormone release from the posterior pituitary

words.enDefinition: Narrow connection between the hypothalamus and pituitary at the brain base

examples.en: The pituitary stalk links the small gland to the brain region above it.
examples.zh: 「垂体柄」把这个小腺体与其上方的脑区连接起来。

examples.en: We marked the pituitary stalk before labeling the two lobes on the model.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「垂体柄」，再标注模型中的两个叶。

words.enDefinition: Blood vessels carrying hypothalamic signals directly to the anterior pituitary

examples.en: The hypothalamic-pituitary portal system links two capillary networks in the colored textbook figure.
examples.zh: 「下丘脑垂体门脉系统」在彩色教材图中连接两个毛细血管网。

examples.en: We traced the hypothalamic-pituitary portal system from the upper network to the anterior lobe.
examples.zh: 我们沿「下丘脑垂体门脉系统」从上方的血管网追踪到垂体前叶。

collocations: diagram of the hypothalamic-pituitary portal system
signaling through the hypothalamic-pituitary portal system

words.enDefinition: Anterior pituitary signal that supports body growth and influences nutrient use

examples.en: The chart lists growth hormone among the signals produced by the front lobe.
examples.zh: 图表将「生长激素」列为垂体前叶产生的信号之一。

examples.en: We marked the source of growth hormone on the simplified endocrine diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在简化内分泌图中标出了「生长激素」的来源。

collocations: growth hormone from the anterior pituitary

words.enDefinition: Anterior pituitary signal stimulating the thyroid to produce and release thyroid hormones

examples.en: The arrow for thyroid-stimulating hormone runs from the pituitary toward the thyroid.
examples.zh: 表示「促甲状腺激素」的箭头从垂体指向甲状腺。

examples.en: We labeled thyroid-stimulating hormone as the intervening signal in this endocrine diagram.
examples.zh: 我们将「促甲状腺激素」标为这张内分泌图中的中间信号。

words.enDefinition: Anterior pituitary signal stimulating the adrenal cortex, particularly its cortisol secretion

examples.en: The chart shows adrenocorticotropic hormone traveling from the pituitary to the adrenal cortex.
examples.zh: 图表显示「促肾上腺皮质激素」从垂体到达肾上腺皮质。

examples.en: We marked the gland that responds to adrenocorticotropic hormone in the classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂模型中标出了对「促肾上腺皮质激素」作出响应的腺体。

words.enDefinition: Hormone released from the posterior pituitary that increases kidney water reabsorption

examples.en: The flowchart connects antidiuretic hormone with water movement in the collecting duct.
examples.zh: 流程图将「抗利尿激素」与集合管中的水分转运联系起来。

examples.en: We marked the release site for antidiuretic hormone on the simplified pituitary diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在简化垂体图中标出了「抗利尿激素」的释放部位。

words.enDefinition: Endocrine organ in the front of the neck that produces thyroid hormones

examples.en: The thyroid gland lies across the front of the airway in the model.
examples.zh: 模型中，「甲状腺」横跨气道的前方。

examples.en: We labeled the thyroid gland before identifying the neighboring structures in the neck.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「甲状腺」，再辨认颈部邻近结构。

words.enDefinition: Spherical unit of thyroid tissue surrounding a central storage space

examples.en: The atlas shows each thyroid follicle as a ring of cells in section.
examples.zh: 图谱显示，每个「甲状腺滤泡」在切面中呈一圈细胞。

examples.en: We marked the center of the thyroid follicle before labeling the cell layer.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「甲状腺滤泡」的中央，再标出围绕它的一层细胞。

words.enDefinition: Thyroid-produced messenger that helps regulate metabolic activity, growth, and development

examples.en: The model connects thyroid hormone with changes in activity across several tissues.
examples.zh: 模型将「甲状腺激素」与多种组织的活动变化联系起来。

examples.en: We placed thyroid hormone at the peripheral end of the endocrine feedback diagram.
examples.zh: 我们把「甲状腺激素」放在内分泌反馈图的外周末端。

words.enDefinition: Major thyroid hormone, also called T4, that can be converted to T3

examples.en: The teaching chart identifies thyroxine as the hormone labeled T4 beside the thyroid.
examples.zh: 教学图表将甲状腺旁标为 T4 的激素辨认为「甲状腺素」。

examples.en: We placed thyroxine before T3 on the simplified hormone relationship diagram.
examples.zh: 在简化的激素关系图中，我们把「甲状腺素」放在 T3 前面。

words.enDefinition: Active thyroid hormone known as T3, often formed from circulating T4

examples.en: The chart labels triiodothyronine as the active hormone indicated by T3.
examples.zh: 图表将「三碘甲状腺原氨酸」标为缩写 T3 所指的活性激素。

examples.en: We identified triiodothyronine after following the arrow leading from T4 on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们沿图中从 T4 出发的箭头，找到了「三碘甲状腺原氨酸」。

words.enDefinition: Small endocrine organ usually behind the thyroid that helps regulate blood calcium

examples.en: We found a parathyroid gland on the back view of the neck model.
examples.zh: 我们在颈部模型的后视图上找到了一个「甲状旁腺」。

examples.en: The diagram marks each parathyroid gland separately from the surrounding thyroid tissue.
examples.zh: 示意图将各个「甲状旁腺」与周围的甲状腺组织分开标注。

words.enDefinition: Parathyroid signal that raises blood calcium through effects on several organs

examples.en: The teaching diagram connects parathyroid hormone with the regulation of calcium in blood.
examples.zh: 教学图把「甲状旁腺激素」与血钙调节联系起来。

examples.en: We marked the source of parathyroid hormone on the back view of the thyroid.
examples.zh: 我们在甲状腺后视图上标出了「甲状旁腺激素」的来源。

words.enDefinition: Hormone from thyroid cells that can reduce calcium release from bone

examples.en: The worksheet lists calcitonin as a signal from cells between thyroid follicles.
examples.zh: 习题把「降钙素」列为甲状腺滤泡之间细胞所产生的一种信号。

examples.en: We labeled calcitonin separately from the other thyroid signals on the chart.
examples.zh: 我们在图表中将「降钙素」与甲状腺的其他信号分开标注。

words.enDefinition: Endocrine organ on top of each kidney with an outer and inner region

examples.en: The adrenal gland appears above the kidney in the front view of the model.
examples.zh: 在模型正视图中，「肾上腺」位于肾脏上方。

examples.en: We marked the adrenal gland separately from the larger organ beneath it.
examples.zh: 我们把「肾上腺」和它下方较大的器官分开标注。

words.enDefinition: Outer region of an adrenal gland that produces steroid hormones

examples.en: The adrenal cortex forms the outer band of the gland in our diagram.
examples.zh: 图中，「肾上腺皮质」形成腺体的外带。

examples.en: We placed the hormone labels beside the adrenal cortex on the classroom figure.
examples.zh: 我们把激素标签放在课堂图中「肾上腺皮质」的旁边。

words.enDefinition: Inner region of an adrenal gland that releases epinephrine and related signals

examples.en: The adrenal medulla occupies the inner region of the sliced model gland.
examples.zh: 「肾上腺髓质」占据剖开腺体模型的内部区域。

examples.en: We colored the adrenal medulla differently from the gland's outer band.
examples.zh: 我们用不同颜色区分「肾上腺髓质」和腺体外带。

words.enDefinition: Adrenal cortex hormone involved in regulating metabolism and responses to stress

examples.en: The endocrine chart shows cortisol as an output of the adrenal cortex.
examples.zh: 内分泌图表将「皮质醇」表示为肾上腺皮质的一项输出信号。

examples.en: We marked cortisol on the feedback arrow in the synthetic diagram.
examples.zh: 我们把「皮质醇」标在合成示意图的反馈箭头上。

words.enDefinition: Adrenal hormone promoting sodium reabsorption and potassium secretion in the kidney

examples.en: The flowchart links aldosterone to sodium movement in the later tubular segments.
examples.zh: 流程图把「醛固酮」与后段肾小管里的钠转运联系起来。

examples.en: We placed aldosterone among the signals leaving the adrenal cortex on the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们在示意图中将「醛固酮」列入肾上腺皮质释放的信号。

words.enDefinition: Hormonal signal from the adrenal medulla that helps coordinate acute stress responses

examples.en: We placed epinephrine beside the output arrow from the adrenal medulla.
examples.zh: 我们将「肾上腺素」标在肾上腺髓质的输出箭头旁。

examples.en: The lecture chart shows epinephrine as one signal in the short-term stress response.
examples.zh: 课堂图表将「肾上腺素」列为短期应激反应中的一种信号。

words.enDefinition: Hormone-producing pancreatic tissue organized into small groups of cells called islets

examples.en: The atlas shows the endocrine pancreas as small clusters within the larger gland.
examples.zh: 图谱把「胰腺内分泌部」画成这座较大腺体内的小细胞簇。

examples.en: We colored the endocrine pancreas separately from the tissue connected to the ducts.
examples.zh: 我们分别给「胰腺内分泌部」和连有导管的组织涂上不同的颜色。

words.enDefinition: Cluster of hormone-secreting cells within the endocrine portion of the pancreas

examples.en: The pancreatic islet looks like a pale cluster in the textbook illustration.
examples.zh: 教材插图中的「胰岛」呈现为浅色细胞簇。

examples.en: We enlarged one pancreatic islet to show several different cell types inside it.
examples.zh: 我们放大一个「胰岛」，展示其中的多种细胞类型。

words.enDefinition: Cell in a pancreatic islet that produces and releases insulin

examples.en: We labeled a pancreatic beta cell beside the arrow for insulin in the illustration.
examples.zh: 我们在插图中胰岛素的箭头旁标出了一个「胰岛β细胞」。

examples.en: The worksheet groups each pancreatic beta cell with other cells of the same islet.
examples.zh: 习题将各个「胰岛β细胞」与同一胰岛内的其他细胞画在一起。

collocations: secretion by a pancreatic beta cell
diagram of a pancreatic beta cell

words.enDefinition: Cell in a pancreatic islet that produces and releases glucagon

examples.en: The pancreatic alpha cell has an arrow leading to glucagon in our diagram.
examples.zh: 示意图中，从「胰岛α细胞」画出的箭头指向胰高血糖素。

examples.en: We colored one pancreatic alpha cell to identify its location in the islet.
examples.zh: 我们给一个「胰岛α细胞」涂上颜色，标出它在胰岛内的位置。

collocations: secretion by a pancreatic alpha cell
diagram of a pancreatic alpha cell

words.enDefinition: Pancreatic hormone that helps lower blood glucose and promotes nutrient storage

examples.en: The diagram places insulin beside the arrow from the islet beta cells.
examples.zh: 示意图将「胰岛素」标在从胰岛β细胞引出的箭头旁。

examples.en: The chart shows insulin helping lower glucose in a simulated feedback loop.
examples.zh: 图表显示，在模拟反馈回路中，「胰岛素」有助于降低血糖。

words.enDefinition: Pancreatic hormone that helps raise blood glucose, mainly through actions on the liver

examples.en: The flowchart connects glucagon with glucose released from the modeled liver.
examples.zh: 流程图将「胰高血糖素」与模型肝脏释放葡萄糖联系起来。

examples.en: We labeled glucagon beside the signal arrow leaving an islet alpha cell.
examples.zh: 我们在离开胰岛α细胞的信号箭头旁标出了「胰高血糖素」。
